_comment: Waiver register for spm x GF180MCU (plugin v1.5.66, run 2026-07-24). Every deferred step carries evidence + ticket id + review_required:true — a waiver is deferred work, not a free PASS. Authored 2026-07-25 from the run's orchestrator/audit records (addresses review finding F2).

waivers.rationale: IC class 'digital_arithmetic_primitive' registers rtl_gen=null — the deterministic runner has no RTL generator for this class and hands authoring to the AI (skill spec-to-rtl) inside the runner pipeline. The authored RTL passed every downstream gate (lint, sim, synth, LEC). NOTE: this run also re-used the phase1 L-docs and RTL from the sky130A/IHP campaigns (phase1 SKIPPED in vibe_ic_one_shot.json; identical spm.v sha256 across all three cells) — valid as convergence evidence, disclosed here per review finding F6.
waivers.reviewer_action: IC-expert review of the AI-authored spm.v against L1-L9 docs before tapeout release.

waivers.rationale: Analog track (A1-A9) not run: spm is a pure-digital IC and the run was dispatched with --skip-analog. Recorded as WAIVED rather than N/A so the deferral is explicit.
waivers.reviewer_action: Confirm pure-digital classification (ic_class.json) — no analog blocks exist to verify.

waivers.rationale: No DE10-class board-pin contract for this class: verification_track='generic_full_stack', half_duplex_bus=False — the AID half-duplex reference TB cannot bind this interface family, so on-board verification is deferred to board bring-up rather than executed.
waivers.reviewer_action: If silicon shuttle is planned, run a board-level bring-up on the synthesized netlist before release.

waivers.rationale: OSS Fault ATPG could not measure sign-off stuck-at coverage on this netlist (SKIPPED-CONDITION: library-mapped netlist with real stdcell DFFs required). At-speed grading DID run and passed: transition/path-delay/small-delay-defect gates PASS, 65 scan flops, test_coverage 100% with fault_coverage 48.75% (disclosed per review finding F5).
waivers.reviewer_action: Run a full stuck-at ATPG (commercial or AUCOHL Fault full flow) for sign-off coverage; 48.75% transition fault coverage is far below any production floor.
